description: Interface definition for the Cosmology Engine
purpose: Manages primordial darkness, Dark Star collapse into the Divine Core, and the foundation of all cosmic structures

inputs.name: ash_baseline_contract
inputs.description: F2^9 state-space and fixed canonical codeword baseline used by downstream ASH pattern generation.

outputs.name: cosmic_state
outputs.description: The current state of the cosmos including Dark Star and Divine Core creation chain, wolf balance state, and realm configuration

outputs.name: realm_definitions
outputs.description: Definitions for all nine canonical realms

outputs.name: ash_state
outputs.description: Complete F2^9 cosmic state vector supplied to the ASH Pattern Engine.

outputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
outputs.description: Cosmology baseline diagnostic record carried into downstream CosmicPatternSnapshot generation.

methods.name: initialize_cosmos
methods.description: Set up the primordial state and trigger the creation event

methods.name: get_realm_definitions
methods.description: Return the definitions for all nine realms

methods.name: get_wolf_state
methods.description: Return the current state of White Wolf and Dark Wolf companion balance or coherence pressure

methods.name: emit_ash_state_baseline
methods.description: Expose the complete F2^9 AshState and DiagnosticEnvelope consumed by the ASH Pattern Engine to build CosmicPatternSnapshot and GenerationPlan records.

invariants: Nine realms are fixed and canonical
White Wolf and Dark Wolf emerge with Divine Core creation as paired companions of consciousness
Divine Core is the origin center of all reality
Realms and planes are equivalent terms in YWE canon
Wolves may lose coherence temporarily but cannot die permanently
Cosmology output must be representable as a complete F2^9 ASH state before pattern generation.
Downstream transitions use x' = x XOR c over the fixed 16 canonical codewords.
Cosmology does not materialize GenerationPlan outputs or author downstream adapter truth.
CosmicPatternSnapshot, DiagnosticEnvelope, and GenerationPlan remain downstream ASH provenance requirements.

ash_remediation_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_remediation_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
ash_remediation_contract.engine_contract_rule: Cosmology is the upstream source of complete ASH state; materialization remains downstream of GenerationPlan.
